definition: Consisting of seven; recurring every seven years. As a noun, a group or period of seven.
etymology: From Latin septenarius, “containing seven,” built on septeni, “seven each.” It carries a quiet September echo: September was once the seventh month of the Roman year, before January and February were set at its beginning.
usage: The village kept a septenary cycle of fairs, so this autumn’s gathering promised uncommon bustle.
